title: Designs Direct Recalls Cupcakes and Cashmere Brand Three-Light Floor Lamps, Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: When plugged in or switched on, the lamp cord or internal wiring can smoke, melt, spark, overheat or ignite, posing a risk of serious injury from fire and burn hazards. Units: About 4,200.

title: Gazelle USA Recalls Urban Arrow Cargo Electric Bikes Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The front bolt in the seat post clamping mechanism can break, causing the seat to become loose, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 1,032 (In addition, about 134 were sold in Canada).

title: Gobi Heat Recalls Rechargeable Hand Warmers Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The lithium-ion battery and electrical components in the recalled hand warmers can overheat and ignite, posing a risk of serious injury from fire and burn hazards. Units: About 5,500 (In addition, about 47 were sold in Canada).

title: YunHeng Recalls LandTale Bed Rails Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Entrapment and Asphyxiation; Violate Mandatory Standard for Adult Portable Bed Rails
